apply_fn_to_tree_leaves: apply a function to every leaf value in a nested list, tuple, or dict using tree_map
transform_tensor_tree: transform all tensors in a nested structure by moving them to a different device with tree_map
cast_tree_values: cast all float values in a nested tree to a different dtype using tree_map with a lambda
map_nested_structure: recursively map a function over a deeply nested structure of lists and dicts using tree_map
summarize_tree_map: summarize how tree_map flattens a nested tree, applies a function to each leaf, and reconstructs the tree
